article.title: Limitation of time for application for curator.
article.content: An application under this Part to the District Judge must be made within six months of the death of the proprietor whose property is claimed by right in succession.
article.html:
205Limitation of time for application for curator.

Section 205 · Part VII · page 66 of the Act

An application under this Part to the District Judge must be made within six months of the death of the proprietor whose property is claimed by right in succession.
